class.name: OcgTransferResultfrommodel
class.brief_description: ResultFromModel is used to store a final result stored in a TransientProcess, respectfully to its structuration in scopes by using a set of ResultFromTransient Hence, it can be regarded as a passive equivalent of the stored data in the TransientProcess, while an Iterator gives a flat view of it.
class.description: ! ResultFromModel is used to store a final result stored in a ! TransientProcess, respectfully to its structuration in scopes ! by using a set of ResultFromTransient ! Hence, it can be regarded as a passive equivalent of the ! stored data in the TransientProcess, while an Iterator gives ! a flat view of it. ! ! A ResultFromModel is intended to be attached to the transfer ! of one entity (typically root entity but it is not mandatory) ! ! It is then possible to : ! - Create and fill a ResultFromModel from a TransientProcess, ! by designating a starting entity ! - Fill back the TransientProcess from a ResultFromModel, as it ! were filled by the operation which filled it the first time

method.name: Model
method.description: Returns starting Model (null if not set)

method.name: FileName
method.description: Returns starting File Name (empty if not set)

method.name: Fill
method.description: Fills from a TransientProcess, with the result attached to a starting entity. Considers its Model if it is set. This action produces a structured set of ResultFromTransient, considering scopes, starting by that of <ent>. If <ent> has no recorded result, it remains empty Returns True if a result is recorded, False else

method.name: Strip
method.description: Clears some data attached to binders used by TransientProcess, which become useless once the transfer has been done, by calling Strip on its ResultFromTransient

method.name: FillBack
method.description: Fills back a TransientProcess from the structured set of binders. Also sets the Model.

method.name: HasResult
method.description: Returns True if a Result is recorded

method.name: MainResult
method.description: Returns the main recorded ResultFromTransient, or a null

method.name: SetMainResult
method.description: Sets a new value for the main recorded ResultFromTransient

method.name: MainLabel
method.description: Returns the label in starting model attached to main entity (updated by Fill or SetMainResult, if Model is known)

method.name: MainNumber
method.description: Returns the label in starting model attached to main entity

method.name: ResultFromKey
method.description: Searches for a key (starting entity) and returns its result Returns a null handle if not found

method.name: Results
method.description: Internal method which returns the list of ResultFromTransient, according level (2:complete; 1:sub-level 1; 0:main only)

method.name: TransferredList
method.description: Returns the list of recorded starting entities, ending by the root. Entities with check but no transfer result are ignored <level> = 2 (D), considers the complete list <level> = 1 considers the main result plus immediate subs <level> = 0 just the main result

method.name: CheckList
method.description: Returns the check-list of this set of results <erronly> true : only fails are considered <level> = 0 : considers only main binder <level> = 1 : considers main binder plus immediate subs <level> = 2 (D) : considers all checks
